title: Isolation of polymorphonuclear neutrophils and monocytes from a single sample of human peripheral blood
protocol: Gently layer 30 mL of pre-diluted blood into each Ficoll-Paque PLUS-loaded LeucosepTM tube.
Centrifuge tubes at 800×g for 15 min at 18°C–22°C using a swinging bucket rotor with the brake set to “off” or deceleration set to 0.
Remove tubes from the centrifuge gently so as not to disturb the layers.
Maintain isolation temperature between 18°C and 22°C.
Aspirate and discard the top plasma layer until approximately 5–10 mm above the interphase of the PBMC layer.
Harvest the PBMC layer using a transfer pipette.
Transfer harvested PBMCs into a new 50 mL conical tube.
Transfer the PBMC layer from each LeucosepTM tube into separate 50 mL conical tubes.
Resuspend cells in a small volume of 1 mL.
Top up to 50 mL with PBS/EDTA for each wash.
Centrifuge at 300×g at 18°C–22°C for 8 min.
Gently aspirate out the supernatant.
Repeat steps 6–8 at least twice, or until the supernatant is clear.
Centrifuge the sample at 300×g for 10 minutes to eliminate platelets.
Combine all cell pellets by resuspending in 1 mL of 1× RBC lysis buffer.
Transfer cells to a new 50 mL conical tube and add 1× RBC lysis buffer up to a final volume of 10 mL.
Incubate the sample at 18°C–22°C for 5 minutes.
Neutralize RBC lysis buffer by adding 10 mL of PBS/EDTA.
Centrifuge at 500×g for 5 minutes at 18°C–22°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend cells in 10 mL isolation buffer per 50 mL blood volume.
Count cells and set aside 0.5 million cells for flow cytometry analysis.
Keep samples at 4°C to preserve monocyte viability.
Adjust the centrifuge temperature to 4°C and keep all buffers on ice.
Centrifuge cells at 500×g for 5 minutes.
Gently aspirate the supernatant from the cells.
Add 80 μL isolation buffer + 20 μL CD14 MicroBeads for up to each 10 million cells.
For 10–20 million cells, adjust to 160 μL isolation buffer + 40 μL CD14 MicroBeads.
For 20–30 million cells, adjust to 240 μL isolation buffer + 60 μL CD14 MicroBeads.
Thoroughly mix the MicroBeads immediately before adding to cells by gently vortexing or pipetting.
Gently mix the CD14 MicroBeads with cells and incubate for 15 minutes at 4°C in a 4°C fridge.
Top up to 30 mL with isolation buffer and centrifuge at 500×g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Set up the magnetic stand and column while samples are spinning.
Place columns tightly in the magnet.
Orient the front face of the LS column outwards.
Place a tube or reservoir below the column to collect flowthrough and washes.
Equilibrate the column by passing 3 mL isolation buffer through it.
Remove supernatant from samples after centrifuging.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL isolation buffer for up to 10^6 cells.
Transfer cell suspension to the column.
Wash the column with 3 mL isolation buffer three times.
Remove the column from the magnetic rack and place it in a 15 mL conical tube.
Add 5 mL isolation buffer and push through the column into a collection tube immediately.
Count cells collected and save 0.2 million for flow cytometry analysis.
Transfer LS column to a 15 mL conical tube.
Elute monocytes with a plunger.
Aspirate the layer above the porous barrier.
Remove the porous barrier using a 2 mL sterile serological pipette and tweezers.
Centrifuge the tube at 500×g for 5 min at 18°C–22°C if the bottom RBC layer is disturbed during barrier removal.
Aspirate and discard the Ficoll-Plaque PLUS gradient carefully without disturbing the dark red pellet.
Top up to 50 mL with 1×RBC lysis buffer for each tube (tube 0).
Centrifuge tubes at 500×g for 5 min at 18°C–22°C (tube 0).
Directly transfer top 20 mL from this tube (tube 0) into a new tube (new tube 1).
Transfer the next 20 mL out into another new tube (new tube 2).
Add 30 mL of 1×RBC lysis buffer to tube 1.
Add 40 mL of 1×RBC lysis buffer to tube 2.
Add 1×RBC lysis buffer to tube 0, up to the specified volume.
Incubate all tubes at 18°C–22°C for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge all tubes at 500×g for 5 minutes at 18°C–22°C.
Gently remove supernatant from each tube and resuspend pellet in 1 mL of 1×RBC lysis buffer.
Combine up to six tubes together and top up to 50 mL with 1×RBC lysis buffer.
Incubate combined tubes at 18°C–22°C for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge combined tubes at 500×g for 5 minutes at 18°C–22°C.
Aspirate supernatant and wash cell pellet with 15 mL of PBS.
Centrifuge washed cells at 500×g for 5 minutes at 18°C–22°C.
Gently remove the supernatant from the centrifuged cells.
Resuspend cells in PBS to achieve a concentration of approximately 1–5 million cells/mL.
Set aside 0.5 million PMNs at 18°C–22°C for flow cytometry analysis.
Stain 0.2 million purified monocytes or PMNs with the appropriate antibodies and cell viability dye in a flow tube at 18°C–22°C for 15 min or 4°C for 30 min.
Add 700 μl of flow staining buffer to each flow tube after staining.
Centrifuge at 500×g for 5 min at 18°C–22°C.
Discard the supernatant gently.
Add 300 μL of flow staining buffer.
Analyze in a flow cytometer.
Observe PMNs for apoptosis starting within 2 hours post-isolation.
Note that almost all PMNs are dead within 24 hours.
